boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Franciscan University of Steubenville
boards.description: Ten current, under-21-safe Steubenville destinations with publicly posted late hours.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Sunset Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 2118 Sunset Blvd, Steubenville
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when you need a late food stop; the location posts drive-thru service until 4 a.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: A Sunset Boulevard drive-thru with the latest posted hours in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours of 9 a.m.–4 a.m. Sunday through Saturday at 2118 Sunset Blvd.
cards.access_notes: Posted drive-thru hours are 9 a.m.–4 a.m. daily; dine-in hours differ.

cards.title: Domino’s on Sunset Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 2825 Sunset Blvd, Steubenville
cards.notes: Place a carryout or delivery order through the store page, which currently lists service until 1 a.m. today.
cards.short_summary: A pizza option whose official store page displays a 1 a.m. closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official Steubenville store page lists the 2825 Sunset Blvd location as open until 1 a.m. today.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 2825 Sunset Blvd, Steubenville
cards.access_notes: The official store page currently shows “Open Today Until 1:00 AM”; check the page when ordering because hours can vary.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Sunset Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 2206 Sunset Blvd, Steubenville
cards.notes: Choose dine-in, drive-thru, or applicable ordering options before midnight; the restaurant posts the same daily close time.
cards.short_summary: A listed midnight stop along Sunset Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 8 a.m.–12 a.m. every day at 2206 Sunset Blvd.
cards.access_notes: Posted restaurant and drive-thru hours are 8 a.m.–12 a.m. daily; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Eat’n Park at Fort Steuben Mall
cards.subtitle: 100 Mall Dr, Steubenville
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s pickup window or order ahead if you want food later in the evening; its posted hours run to 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A full-service and takeout option with an 11 p.m. posted close.
cards.evidence_claim: Eat’n Park lists its Steubenville restaurant at 100 Mall Dr as open 7 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Posted business hours are 7 a.m.–11 p.m. daily; pickup window and delivery are listed services.

cards.title: Walmart Supercenter at Fort Steuben Mall
cards.subtitle: 100 Mall Dr, Steubenville
cards.notes: For groceries or supplies rather than a meal, plan the stop before 11 p.m.; individual in-store services close earlier.
cards.short_summary: A late evening option for food staples and practical supplies.
cards.evidence_claim: Walmart lists Steubenville Supercenter #2193 at 100 Mall Dr as open 6 a.m.–11 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Posted store hours are 6 a.m.–11 p.m. daily; departments and services have separate hours.

cards.title: KFC on Sunset Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 4187 Sunset Blvd, Steubenville
cards.notes: Use carryout, delivery, or the drive-thru before the posted 10:30 p.m. close, and confirm the service you need before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A Sunset Boulevard food stop listed through 10:30 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: KFC lists hours of 10:30 a.m.–10:30 p.m. every day for its 4187 Sunset Boulevard restaurant.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are 10:30 a.m.–10:30 p.m. daily; the location lists carryout, delivery, and drive-thru.

cards.title: China Garden
cards.subtitle: Steubenville, Ohio
cards.notes: Order pickup or local delivery from the restaurant’s own site; Friday and Saturday hours are posted until 10:30 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A locally operated pickup and delivery option that runs later on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: China Garden posts hours until 10:30 p.m. Friday and Saturday and until 10 p.m. Sunday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: 10:30 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday; pickup and delivery within seven miles are listed.

cards.title: The Ville Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 100 Mall Dr, Steubenville
cards.notes: For a seated or carry-out dinner, aim for Friday or Saturday when the kitchen is posted through 10 p.m.; confirm before departing.
cards.short_summary: A family-owned Fort Steuben Mall restaurant with a later weekend kitchen close.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ville posts kitchen hours of 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Friday and Saturday, with earlier closing times on other days.
cards.access_notes: Kitchen hours are posted until 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday; this card refers to restaurant food service, not the bar.

cards.title: McDonald’s on Sunset Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 2106 Sunset Blvd, Steubenville
cards.notes: This location is listed as open around the clock; use its drive-thru or ordering options and verify availability in real time.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour listed food stop on Sunset Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Apple Maps lists the McDonald’s at 2106 Sunset Blvd as open 24 hours every day, including drive-through service.
cards.access_notes: Apple Maps lists the restaurant and drive-through as open 24 hours daily; confirm live service availability before travel.

cards.title: Jimmy John’s at Franciscan Square
cards.subtitle: 225 Franciscan Sq, Steubenville
cards.notes: For an on-foot Franciscan Square food option, order pickup or delivery before 9 p.m.; the location also lists indoor seating.
cards.short_summary: A campus-adjacent sandwich shop with daily 9 p.m. service.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy John’s lists its 225 Franciscan Sq store hours and delivery hours as 10:30 a.m.–9 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Posted store and delivery hours are 10:30 a.m.–9 p.m. daily; delivery is subject to area availability.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented recurring practices that organize Franciscan University’s faith-household life, worship, and Homecoming observances.

cards.title: Join a Faith Household
cards.subtitle: Student-led Christian communities
cards.notes: Attend an early-semester Household Information Meeting, meet members, and use the Household Life process if a prayer-and-service community fits you.
cards.short_summary: A long-running campus system of student faith communities built around a shared covenant.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan describes households as same-sex groups of three or more students, and its history identifies them as a cherished campus tradition begun in 1974.
cards.access_notes: Membership is voluntary; the university directs new students to information meetings during the first weeks of the semester.

cards.title: Make the Household Covenant
cards.subtitle: The shared pledge behind each household
cards.notes: If you explore a household, read its covenant closely and ask members how its common commitment shapes prayer, support, and service.
cards.short_summary: Each household’s written pledge gives the group its spiritual identity and common commitment.
cards.evidence_claim: The Household Life office states that every household is founded on a written pledge called a household covenant.
cards.access_notes: Contact Household Life or attend a household meeting for participation details.

cards.title: Gather for Household Life Mass
cards.subtitle: Finnegan Fieldhouse, once each semester
cards.notes: Check the Chapel Ministries schedule and arrive before the listed start if you want to see the semester’s household-focused liturgy together.
cards.short_summary: A semesterly Mass dedicated to the faith households that structure much of campus community life.
cards.evidence_claim: Chapel Ministries says Household Life Mass is held once per semester in Finnegan Fieldhouse to celebrate the university’s faith households.
cards.access_notes: The Spring 2026 schedule lists April 17 at 4:45 p.m.; verify future dates on the Chapel Ministries schedule.

cards.title: Watch the Household Banners Process In
cards.subtitle: Part of Household Life Mass
cards.notes: At a Household Life Mass, look for representatives of each household carrying its banner in the procession before settling into the liturgy.
cards.short_summary: A visual roll call of Franciscan’s households, each represented by its own banner.
cards.evidence_claim: The university’s Chapel Ministries schedule specifies that the Household Life Mass procession includes members of every household carrying their household banner.
cards.access_notes: Occurs as part of the once-per-semester Household Life Mass; confirm dates and location on the schedule.

cards.title: Follow the Household Awards
cards.subtitle: Annual recognition within Household Life
cards.notes: Review the award descriptions and winners to see how Household Life publicly recognizes long-term evangelization, conversion, and servant leadership.
cards.short_summary: A recurring recognition tradition for households and their coordinators.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan’s Household Awards page says awards are presented each year to households and individuals for evangelization, penance, servant leadership, and perseverance.
cards.access_notes: See the Household Life site for current winners and award information.

cards.title: Take Part in Festival of Praise
cards.subtitle: Monthly campus praise, adoration, and prayer
cards.notes: Use the Chapel Ministries schedule for the current date, then join the evening of praise music, adoration, a talk, and optional prayer-team ministry.
cards.short_summary: A monthly worship gathering coordinated by the Steubenville Conference Office and Office of Evangelization.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Evangelization describes Festival of Praise as a monthly gathering with adoration, praise and worship music, a talk, and prayer-team ministry.
cards.access_notes: The 2025–2026 schedule lists Festivals of Praise at 7:00 p.m.; confirm venue and date before attending.

cards.title: See the Austria Send-off Mass
cards.subtitle: Christ the King Chapel
cards.notes: If you are in the Austria program community, check Chapel Ministries for the announced date and attend the dedicated send-off liturgy before departure.
cards.short_summary: A named campus Mass marking the departure of students connected with Franciscan’s Austria program.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan’s current Chapel Ministries schedule includes an Austria Send-off Mass in Christ the King Chapel.
cards.access_notes: The Spring 2026 listing marks the date TBD; consult the schedule for the announced time.

cards.entity_name: Community Rosary led by Knights of the Holy Queen
cards.title: Pray the Community Rosary
cards.subtitle: Led by the Knights of the Holy Queen Household
cards.notes: Join the weekday rosary at its listed chapel time, or check the Chapel Ministries schedule first in case the university updates the routine.
cards.short_summary: A recurring weekday devotion led by one named Franciscan faith household.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chapel Ministries schedule lists a Monday–Friday Community Rosary led by the Knights of the Holy Queen Household.
cards.access_notes: Listed Monday through Friday at 11:00 a.m.; confirm the location and schedule before going.

cards.title: Return for the St. Francis Festival
cards.subtitle: Homecoming Weekend observance
cards.notes: Check the annual Homecoming schedule for the festival’s location and bring time for the listed crafts, games, food, and St. Francis programming.
cards.short_summary: A named Homecoming festival that places St. Francis-themed programming alongside family activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan’s 2025 Homecoming coverage identifies the St. Francis Festival as part of the university’s annual Homecoming Weekend.
cards.access_notes: The 2026 Homecoming schedule is marked tentative; verify the current program before planning around it.

cards.title: Follow the Memorial Races
cards.subtitle: Annual Homecoming Weekend races at Assisi Heights
cards.notes: Consult the Homecoming program for race details and spectator logistics, then support the runners during the named Saturday morning memorial event.
cards.short_summary: A named annual Homecoming race tradition held on the Franciscan campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan’s Homecoming 2025 announcement calls the Kelly Roggensack Memorial Races an annual event held on campus at Assisi Heights.
cards.access_notes: This event is scheduled as part of Homecoming; check the current Homecoming page for registration and timing.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Franciscan University of Steubenville, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A campus-centered first-weekend sequence, followed by two daylight Steubenville stops with documented public-facing activities.

cards.title: Start at Christ the King Chapel
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · campus
cards.notes: Use the chapel plaza as a clear meeting point, then check Chapel Ministries’ current schedule before attending Mass or prayer.
cards.short_summary: A central campus chapel and scheduled worship site.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan’s orientation schedule lists campus tours from Christ the King Chapel Plaza and a Saturday vigil Mass at Christ the King Chapel.
cards.access_notes: Consult the current Chapel Ministries schedule for service times and any access changes.

cards.title: Have your first campus dinner
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Antonian Hall
cards.notes: Meet your new neighbors for dinner in the dining hall; confirm your meal-plan or guest-pass access before you go.
cards.short_summary: The campus dining hall appears repeatedly on the new-student schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan’s 2026 orientation schedule places Friday dinner, Saturday meals, and Sunday brunch in Antonian Hall.
cards.access_notes: Dining access may require an ID, meal plan, guest pass, or payment; verify with campus dining.

cards.title: Catch a Fieldhouse welcome event
cards.subtitle: Friday night · Finnegan Fieldhouse
cards.notes: Check the student calendar for a scheduled program, then use the Fieldhouse as the next shared stop after dinner.
cards.short_summary: A large campus venue used for orientation and faith-life programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan’s orientation schedule lists its Grand Opening in Finnegan Fieldhouse, and Chapel Ministries lists Festivals of Praise there.
cards.access_notes: Attendance and entry depend on the specific scheduled event; check the current student calendar.

cards.title: Make a plan at the J.C.
cards.subtitle: Friday night · J.C. Williams Center
cards.notes: Use the student center to reconnect with your group and look for the weekend’s posted campus activities before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A student-center stop that hosts orientation social programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan identifies the J.C. Williams Center as the student center, and its 2026 orientation schedule places a new-student dance there.
cards.source_title: Where Will You Be on Campus?
cards.access_notes: Building access and event entry vary; consult Student Life or the posted event details.

cards.title: Set up a library study stop
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · campus
cards.notes: Find the quiet areas, computer lab, and group rooms now, then bookmark the library site for its current hours and services.
cards.short_summary: A two-floor academic hub with individual and group study options.
cards.evidence_claim: The St. John Paul II Library says its building has quiet study areas, a computer lab, and group study rooms across two floors.
cards.source_title: About the St. John Paul II Library
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current hours page and room policies before visiting.

cards.title: Take a quiet Portiuncula pause
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · opposite Christ the King Chapel
cards.notes: Walk to the small stone chapel for quiet individual prayer or reflection; keep voices low and check bulletin exceptions first.
cards.short_summary: A replica chapel on campus dedicated to quiet prayer and adoration.
cards.evidence_claim: Chapel Ministries describes the Portiuncula as a campus recreation of the original and says it is mainly reserved for quiet prayer and adoration.
cards.access_notes: The page states daily 8 a.m.–8 p.m. access except when school-year perpetual adoration is active; check the Chapel Bulletin for exceptions.

cards.title: Walk the hillside Stations
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · behind the Portiuncula
cards.notes: Use daylight and sturdy shoes for the hillside path; move at a reflective pace and leave time to view the full sequence.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor, hillside devotional walk with 15 stations.
cards.evidence_claim: Chapel Ministries locates the outdoor Stations behind the Portiuncula and describes a hillside path with 14 stations plus a 15th at the top.
cards.source_title: The Stations of the Cross | Chapel Ministries
cards.access_notes: Use the path only in suitable weather and daylight; this is an outdoor hillside route.

cards.title: Check for an Anathan Theatre showcase
cards.subtitle: Saturday or Sunday · Egan Hall
cards.notes: See whether the theatre program has a public showcase on the calendar, and confirm the performance time and entry details before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A named Egan Hall performance venue used in orientation programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan’s 2026 orientation schedule lists the FUS Theatre Program Showcase: The Actor Games at Anathan Theatre in Egan Hall.
cards.access_notes: This card depends on a scheduled performance; verify the current theatre calendar and any ticket requirement.

cards.title: Take a daylight mural walk downtown
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · downtown Steubenville
cards.notes: Pick up a map or route advice at the Visitor Center, then photograph murals from public sidewalks while allowing time for the return trip.
cards.short_summary: A self-directed downtown art and local-history activity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Steubenville Visitor Center says the city has 24 larger-than-life murals on downtown buildings and provides maps and information for self-guided tours.
cards.source_title: Build Your Own Itinerary | Steubenville Visitor Center
cards.access_notes: The Visitor Center is at 120 South 3rd Street and publishes seasonal hours; use public sidewalks and observe traffic conditions.

cards.title: Finish at Historic Fort Steuben
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · 120 South 3rd Street
cards.notes: If the fort is in season, take its daytime tour; otherwise stop at the Visitor Center for exhibits, maps, and local context.
cards.short_summary: A reconstructed frontier fort beside Steubenville’s Visitor Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Historic Fort Steuben states that the reconstructed fort is open for tours May 1–October 31 and that the Visitor Center is open year-round on weekdays except holidays.
cards.access_notes: The site lists fort tours May–October and varying Visitor Center hours; confirm the current schedule before traveling downtown.
